description: Tests (1) high-density health info in one turn: shellfish allergy + 3 supplements with doses (vitamin D, magnesium, fish oil) must all be captured; (2) medication discontinuation with specific reason preserved in recall; (3) implicit symptom mentions in non-health context: knee pain while discussing hiking, orthostatic dizziness while discussing coffee; (4) two symptoms reported in one turn (dizziness + foot tingling). Failure modes: only some supplements captured from a busy turn; implicit symptoms not extracted because the user frames them as non-issues; allergy noted only briefly gets dropped.
